data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=5K56pkmf770Q7kNvgFyylZa&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBqTDlMsHR1eYH8JN8Zc2EhCPOMCfnIYG7xqK9wJdfRkw&oe=6724BC1C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=vnILX01tvY4Q7kNvgEA-iia&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC8QAAxwrcLMs9LIqvNHzft_Q7tPBKWUi0JK-Lln-uT9A&oe=6724C5A4)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=a-tsPwjo0aYQ7kNvgEtQTFQ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAgDLxBjBVyJgNduA1sALc_UfLvJ_LKwAZIgDsp5mk_GQ&oe=6724AD07)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-3.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=w4aOlYv7mtQQ7kNvgGTVsyP&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-3.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC6-kEICtX9plEw_en7nLVJ3wKMZcxxJrj2iC6wKYPJyQ&oe=67249FE6)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=zRpduNX3XosQ7kNvgGyVFCh&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDT3gzXVjyOS1JI6ZBj0T1tmiJhu5T8IsvtYfa3qJOdzQ&oe=6724CC58)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=BmK6MAUFp-cQ7kNvgEPWp23&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC6EkDr7RDI8yzSuyjQzZxq_ckBae5be_CD77IwMhGWDw&oe=6724C8D9)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=8as5YNsSrskQ7kNvgHyk-0-&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDqtTNKCrQKVyAyysY2c4FTlqplfWmG1uU4oDeKpHIcdg&oe=6724AEF0)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=4ouaazwEsX8Q7kNvgEkOGeu&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBR1bKN5yU_aa6ehEm557fhzyF45f6e0YIGU0JJ5HKinA&oe=6724D1AA)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=UOMxOinNLvEQ7kNvgFX1efE&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDoRbSx-6TPQcfxFg93cK1x3TDV0cwhOWf_QRIfOsq6aw&oe=6724AD17)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=6CE8rle8UfYQ7kNvgHJqBTD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-xsp1-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDYipeIq_mBdOGlIayD_ZyB0XvpXvcPsgIKESaLiij8HQ&oe=6724C88C)
